result.summary: Several visual/layout problems: truncated restaurant names and category chips, a cut-off bottom card, and a bottom nav item with a missing icon.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated with ellipsis in the Fastest near you row, and the third card is partially clipped off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Give cards consistent width/spacing, allow 2-line titles, or use a horizontal scroll with full names visible on focus.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card is cut off mid-image by the bottom navigation bar, so the offer is only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll content so cards clear the tab bar.

issues.description: The Orders tab in the bottom navigation has no icon (only the label), unlike Home, Search, and Profile.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon to match the other tab items.

issues.description: Category filter chips (e.g. Healthy) overflow and are cut off on the right edge with no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the chip row scrolls horizontally with peek of the next chip or a fade, and avoid clipping the last visible label.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under Fastest near you cards wraps awkwardly (e.g. '€0.90 delivery') and feels cramped under truncated titles.
issues.suggestion: Normalize card typography hierarchy and allow enough height for title + meta without crowding.
